experiment: BUCKET-AGE-HEAD: pit-only covariate bucket head p(bucket | grade_band, age_band) below the grade-monotone constraint (grade-monotone calibration line is CLOSED: X-ISO/E-ISO2/3/4 all rejected)

design.head: p(bucket | grade_band, age_band), pit only; age bands <=22 / 23-24 / 25+ (le22: age<23; 23_24: 23<=age<25; 25p: age>=25); grade bands = the existing 5-point FV tiers (round(fv/5)*5, efv_isotonic_lab._tier); cell empirical partially pooled toward the incumbent p_bucket_given_fv row at the ACTUAL grade with weight n/(n+25); missing age or missing cell -> incumbent exactly
design.population: resolved labeled pitcher matrix (data/xfv_pitcher_matrix.json): is_pitcher, debuted+busts, bust_recent excluded, censored==False, consensus_fv_raw + target_resolved present (n=1569, all weight 1.0); mirrors efv_model.oos_grades pool restricted to resolved labels
design.conditioning_grade: consensus_fv_raw (the pre-outcome list grade), mirroring the incumbent table's own population convention (published-FV rows); served on xfv_grade exactly as the incumbent already is
design.age_at: decision cutoff (birth_date exact; fallback milb.age advanced by cutoff-vs-season staleness; None -> incumbent fallback)
design.realized_bucket: 6yr-avg annual WAR (target_resolved/6) binned <0.5/1.5/2.5/4.0 (engine bands, efv_isotonic_lab convention)
design.folds: forward-chained decision-year folds 2020-2023, head fit strictly on decision_year < Y; incumbent is the fixed production curve
design.metrics: log-loss clip 1e-6; per-bucket = binary cross-entropy (efv_isotonic_lab.logloss_per_bucket); unweighted means (all rows w=1)

cell_fv45_25p.note: under THIS lab's conventions (resolved pool, consensus-FV grade bands, age at decision cutoff) the fv45/25+ cell is n=8 with empirical p_bust 0.750, and mean realized WAR6 RISES with age inside the fv45 band (0.51 le22 / 1.70 23-24 / 2.51 25+): the registered 0.81 band-empirical figure is not reproduced here

rerun_marker.trigger: the FIRST pipeline run where the 2024 decision fold becomes trainable in the DEBUTED frame (debuted rows with decision_year==2024 carrying resolved censored==False labels; the full-pool 2024 cell is bust-only today and does NOT count)
rerun_marker.action: MANDATORY named re-run of BUCKET-AGE-HEAD (this lab, identical pre-registered gates) before the head may ship or any baseline resets; the Moore-class RP-role cohort resolves only then (improvement-program 2026-07-15: role blindness not gateable until 2024+ cohorts resolve)

diagnostics_post_hoc.label: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC (recorded after the gate ran; NOT a gate condition)
diagnostics_post_hoc.question: how much of the age-head gain is the age covariate vs population-level recalibration of the incumbent to the (bustier) resolved matrix pool?
diagnostics_post_hoc.method: grade-band-only head, identical partial pooling n/(n+25), identical folds; pooled multiclass log-loss on the same 524 eval rows

decomposition.caveat: NOT a clean age-signal estimate: the age head covers only the 40% age-known rows (incumbent fallback elsewhere) and its smaller cells carry much heavier n/(n+25) shrink toward the population-miscalibrated incumbent than the large grade-band cells; a hierarchical variant (age cells shrunk toward the GRADE-BAND empirical rather than the incumbent) was NOT pre-registered and was not gated here

diagnostics_post_hoc.reading: the registered age head is DOMINATED by its own covariate-free ablation on the identical eval rows (pooled 0.30733 vs 0.17907; age-known subset 0.33450 vs 0.26921; 25+ subset 0.28004 vs 0.21162). The G1/G3 passes are therefore driven by population-level recalibration of the incumbent to the bustier resolved pool - the effect class the CLOSED grade-monotone calibration line (X-ISO/E-ISO2/3/4) already established as blocked - not by age information.

notes.population_mismatch: the incumbent p_bucket table is calibrated on the Clemens published-list population; the resolved matrix pool (busts from inactive.json included) is far bustier (fv45 pit band pooled empirical bust ~0.87 vs incumbent 0.51 at fv45), so ANY recalibration toward this pool posts large in-population log-loss gains regardless of covariate
notes.g2_population_caveat: G2 (bench/good) passing here does NOT contradict the E-ISO4 pit-BENCH blocker: that line evaluated the KM full pool (target_censored, censored rows carried with weights); this pre-registration fixed the RESOLVED-only frame, where realized bench/good frequencies are lower and cutting bench/good mass is rewarded
notes.fold_composition: resolved-only framing makes the 2021-2023 eval folds bust-only (debut cohorts 2021+ are censored until they resolve); only the 2020 fold (n=204, 104 debuted / 100 busts) tests non-bust discrimination
notes.moore_motivation_check: the registered motivation numbers do NOT reproduce under the lab conventions: the fv45/25+ cell is n=8 with empirical p_bust 0.750 (claim: 0.81), and mean realized WAR6 RISES with age inside fv45 (0.51/1.70/2.51 across bands) - the within-band age-bust gradient lives at fv40 (25+ bust 0.988, n=81), not at Moore's band; incumbent p_bust(48.0)=0.388 ties the published figure to his pre-overlay grade ~48 (current live grade 45.8 -> incumbent 0.476)
notes.age_missingness: age is recoverable for only 623/1569 resolved rows and missingness correlates with the outcome (busts are 72% of age-missing rows vs 58% of age-known): the head's serve population (live rows, age always present) is NOT the fit population - an additional unpriced train/serve mismatch

loss_ledger.experiment: BUCKET-AGE-HEAD: pit-only p(bucket | grade_band, age_band) below the grade-monotone constraint (partial pooling n/(n+25) toward the incumbent row); the recorded-open covariate path after the grade-monotone calibration line was CLOSED
loss_ledger.hypothesis: within grade bands, age carries real outcome signal (the Moore case: published p_bust 0.388 vs claimed band-empirical 0.81), so an age-banded bucket head improves calibration without touching the grade-only incumbent or its five non-eFV consumers

result.g2_bench_good: PASS bench -11.2% rel / good -17.0% rel (guard was <=+1.0%)
result.g4_monotone: FAIL: 12 band-seam stochastic-ordering violations across all three age bands; worst +0.07621 P(bust) jump crossing INTO the fv35 band at 32.5/32.75 (all-bust empirical cells vs incumbent fallback below support); further seams at 37.5, 47.5, 52.75, 62.75, 67.5, 72.75 (thin n=1-8 cells)

loss_ledger.diagnosis: two independent kill mechanisms: (1) the piecewise (grade_band x age_band) cell structure cannot preserve grade stochastic ordering at band seams when cell empiricals sit far from the incumbent curve - the head does NOT stay 'below the grade-monotone constraint' as designed; (2) the post-hoc ablation shows the registered head is dominated by a covariate-free grade-band recalibration on the same rows, so the G1/G3 gains are population recalibration (the CLOSED line), not age signal
loss_ledger.what_would_be_different: a hierarchical head (age cells shrunk toward the grade-band EMPIRICAL, itself monotone-repaired across bands, e.g. isotonic in grade per age band) plus a serve-population-matched fit frame; requires fresh pre-registration and should wait for the S5 tripwire (2024 debuted cohorts resolving) when the Moore-class RP cohort becomes gateable
loss_ledger.disposition: NO SHIP. Incumbent p_bucket_given_fv untouched in production; candidate implementation preserved in patched/ for the re-run; re-attempt only under the rerun_marker trigger with a redesigned shrink target
